message.content: The cover of Tempo magazine, dated 3-9 Januari 2022, features a person wearing a white hooded hazmat suit, a face mask, and clear protective goggles. This person is shown from the waist up against a blue background. They wear blue gloves and hold a spherical object covered in red protrusions in their right hand, while their left hand is raised in an open gesture. Several similar spherical objects are depicted mid-air around the figure; some have blurred lines trailing upward, indicating motion. Large white block letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, smaller text reads "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The headline in large black serif font at the bottom left reads "Omicron di Pelupuk Mata." Additional text in smaller black font discusses government efforts to contain a new Covid-19 variant. Other article titles include "Tarik-Ulur Peraturan Keamanan Laut H.64" and "Geliat Bisnis Label Musik Digital H.74." A barcode and QR code are visible in the top right corner along with the price "RP 45.000."
